# WhiteBite/remote-devbox-mcp

> Turn your own Windows+Docker machine into a remote devbox that an external coding agent drives through an outbound Cloudflare tunnel.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short, LLM-friendly index of the project.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://github.com/WhiteBite/remote-devbox-mcp#readme): project landing page
- [Issues](https://github.com/WhiteBite/remote-devbox-mcp/issues): roadmap and known gaps
- [README.md](./README.md): install, run and test instructions

## Key facts

- Install: `git clone https://github.com/WhiteBite/remote-devbox-mcp; in home/: copy .env.example .env and fill PROJECT_DIR + tokens`
- Run: `from home/: python devbox.py use <profile>; docker compose up -d; agent side: cd arena && ./mcp check`
- Test: `python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt; python -m pytest`
- Use cases: agent compiles and runs tests for large projects on your CPU/RAM/build cache; work on private code without uploading it anywhere (only tool calls cross the tunnel); preview a running dev server to the agent through a second tunnel; run Windows-native host commands via runner-MCP with argv-only, validated arguments and an audit log; switch project profiles with one command while the tunnel URL stays the same; read-only audit sessions where mutations are denied by permission mode; drive the devbox from a stock MCP client (OpenCode/Codex/Claude) through a stdio adapter; discover every endpoint from a machine-readable manifest with per-endpoint token roles; watch what the agent calls (tools/jobs/permissions) in a local loopback cockpit

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt): the full documentation in a single file
